usage: As a noun, '洗面' refers to the act of washing one's face.
It is commonly used when talking about morning or daily routines.
You can use it to describe the time or habit of face-washing.
It can be the object of verbs like '做' (do) or '完' (finish).
It often appears in sentences with time expressions, like '朝早洗面'.
